label: Explains Required factors in an agency’s authorizing statute
explanation: EPA had to ground its response in the Clean Air Act’s endangerment criteria; unrelated voluntary-program and diplomatic preferences could not justify refusing that inquiry. The Court left the endangerment finding and the role of policy after such a finding undecided.
